mentions.claim_text: The crypto clarity legislation passes by a single vote, with one person reaching across the aisle to make it happen, either in September right after Rosh Hashanah or slipping to January.
mentions.quote: I saw it passing by one vote
mentions.time_phrase: September right after Rosh Hashanah, or January
mentions.falsify_match: The Clarity Act or equivalent passes by a one-vote margin in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It fails, or passes comfortably, or passes outside the window.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown what the price of Bitcoin will be on the day the legislation passes, but does not say the number.
mentions.quote: what the rate will be of Bitcoin on that day
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable while the number is withheld.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail; the figure is not stated.

mentions.claim_text: Major shakings come as first and second amendment freedoms are challenged, with the first amendment the main target.

mentions.falsify_match: Legislation or rulings materially restricting US speech or gun rights.
